correctness.rationale: Dual general position is GP(X) plus convex complement. For diameter-two T_n, disjoint K_n edges ab,cd have four cross edges as all geodesic midpoints. Fix chosen uv and define missing incident-edge label sets A,B. Convexity of complement prohibits distinct b∈A,d∈B because ub,vd have selected midpoint uv. If either missing set empty, one selected star is complete and any extra avoiding-center edge makes a selected geodesic. If both nonempty, forced A=B={w}; for n≥5 distinct remaining p,q create three selected edges on a shortest path, contradiction. For n=4 this leaves only a triangle; verify stars/triangles by clique and convex complement. Independently enumerated every subset of T_n for n=3..6, 33864 masks total, confirming histograms 1+3z+3z²+z³, 1+8z³, 1+5z⁴, 1+6z⁵. General n proof is structural, not finite interpolation.
